Prevents the screen from turning off during slicing, preview loading, and transfers.
Shows progress while a slice continues outside the app.
Alerts show progress and let you cancel after leaving the app. Slicing continues when alerts are off.
Shows one last check before a remote print begins.
Access keys are protected on this device. Unencrypted connections are limited to local addresses.
Models, projects, profiles, and G-code stay on this device unless you choose to export or send them. DuckySlicer has no accounts, ads, or usage tracking.
Imported models, projects, profiles, recent choices, and generated G-code are stored in the app’s private space. Files you export stay where you save them.
Android keeps a slice running when you leave the app. When alerts are on, the progress alert can reopen DuckySlicer or cancel the slice. Models and G-code stay on this device.
Optional OctoPrint and Klipper access keys are protected by Android. Status checks and G-code are sent only to the printer address you add. Uploading a file does not start a print.
DuckySlicer has no developer-run accounts, analytics, ads, or cloud service. The source code page opens only when you choose to view it.
Deleting a printer connection removes its saved access key. Clearing DuckySlicer’s app data or uninstalling it removes its private data. Exported files remain where you saved them.
Save app and device details with a short history of recent problems and how the app last closed. Models, G-code, file names, printer addresses, and access keys are never included.
